actions.name: drive forward at 30 % until another move

control_flow: followInTheDark: if RLIGHT < 60 it looks at the line tracker; otherwise it goes to avoidWalls.
followInTheDark, dark: if the line tracker < 90 % it curves left; else if > 95 % it curves right; else it goes to avoidWalls.
avoidWalls: if LLIGHT < 70 % it checks the side obstacle sensors (turn right for a left obstacle, turn left for a right obstacle, else driveInTheDark); otherwise it goes to driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark: if LLIGHT < 70 % it drives straight forward; otherwise it goes to stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead it stops; otherwise it goes to followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black it curves left; otherwise it curves right.
